format: UCWDC contests, heat order after posting

source.quote_free_summary: Contests post the heats for all divisions, but the exact heat order is not guaranteed; a competitor who fails to report or answer the Floor Coordinator's calls for a heat is disqualified from that dance category.

requirement: A future UCWDC profile permits heat-order adjustments after posting and must not present the posted order as a guarantee; the Floor Coordinator and Contest Coordinator roles are preserved. Who may change the order is not stated.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Design only; no compliance claimed. Not authorized: SQL, migrations, UI, notification, activation. Studio/Custom reorder is DanceFlow policy and never claims this rule.
interpretation_notes: The sentence permits order changes but names no authority; mapping Contest Coordinator or Floor Coordinator to reorder authority needs an owner decision (Q4). Disqualification for failing to report is an event-conduct consequence the platform must not apply automatically. NOT IMPLEMENTED.
decision_refs: OD-26 (owner decision 2026-11-23, Option A: controlled, audited mid-event running-order changes, design-level draft; retrospective audit PR #795)
